standard.summary: 每 N 个 epoch 完全丢弃一次图说（图说变为空字符串），相当于训练 CFG（无条件生成）的能力。
standard.effect: 开启无条件训练后，模型在 CFG=0 时也能生成合理图像，提升生成的 CFG guidance 效果。
standard.whenToUse: 希望提高推理时 CFG guidance 效果时开启（设为 1~5）。对 CFG 要求高的概念 LoRA 有帮助。
standard.avoidWhen: 数据集极小时，无条件训练会占用一部分训练资源学习"无条件"分布，可能影响概念学习效率。

standard_en.summary: Drops the caption entirely once every N epochs (it becomes an empty string), which amounts to training the CFG (unconditional) capability.
standard_en.effect: With unconditional training on, the model still produces sensible images at CFG=0, which improves how CFG guidance behaves at inference.
standard_en.whenToUse: Turn it on (1-5) when you want better CFG guidance at inference. It helps concept LoRAs that lean on CFG.
standard_en.avoidWhen: On a very small dataset, unconditional training spends part of the budget learning the unconditional distribution, which can slow concept learning.

advanced.principle: 无条件训练是 CFG（Classifier-Free Guidance）的基础：模型同时学习条件生成（有 caption）和无条件生成（caption=空），推理时用两者差值作为引导方向。
advanced.tradeoffs: 过少的无条件训练（>5 epoch 才一次）导致 CFG 引导能力弱；过多（每 epoch 一次）占用太多资源。通常设为 1~3 即可。

advanced_en.principle: Unconditional training underpins CFG (Classifier-Free Guidance): the model learns both conditional generation (with caption) and unconditional generation (empty caption), and inference uses the difference between them as the guidance direction.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Too little unconditional training (once per >5 epochs) weakens CFG guidance; too much (every epoch) wastes capacity. Usually 1~3 is right.
